title: 'Told him to tolerate it': Parents regret advice to kid in IIT-B suicide case
content: Sahil Wakode’s parents have alleged that the 19-year-old IIT Bombay student had told them he was facing casteist slurs, humiliation and harassment at the institute for around three months. They demanded a thorough probe into the allegations and immediate action against those found responsible, while expressing faith in the Mumbai Crime Branch investigation. The Crime Branch has recorded the parents’ statements and is expected to question IIT Bombay officials, including professor Suryanarayana Doolla, whose administrative duties have been temporarily withdrawn pending an inquiry.

title: India’s space sovereignty: From building missions to building depth
content: India has proven its capability to design and launch complex spacecraft independently.  The nation now focuses on building industrial depth for space sovereignty and self-reliance.  A burgeoning private sector and numerous startups are transforming India's space ecosystem.  Future missions aim for a space station and lunar exploration by 2040.  Component-level self-reliance remains a critical challenge for sustained space endeavors.

title: MediaTek targets Qualcomm's fortress with an unmatched new weapon
content: MediaTek has taken the lead over Qualcomm by launching the Dimensity 9600 Pro—the world’s first flagship smartphone chip built on TSMC’s 2nm process. The move signals MediaTek's aggressive push into the premium Android market, offering top-tier performance, efficiency, camera power, and on-device AI at a competitive price.

title: Gold jumps 60% to Rs 1.57L from Rs 98,000 a year ago; sales fall 15%, coins gain
content: In Mumbai's spot market on Monday, gold was trading at Rs 1.57 lakh per 10 grams, including 3% goods and services tax. This was around 60% higher than the Rs 98,000 per 10 grams recorded on Ganesh Chaturthi last year, which fell on August 28.

title: Where is the Village? PT Usha questions Asian Games accommodation model
content: Usha, one of India's most successful Asian Games athletes, said an Athletes Village is about more than accommodation. She said it brings athletes from different countries together and creates the atmosphere that is associated with a multi-sport event.

title: ‘Must act now’: Kashmiri leader urges UNHRC action over situation in PoJK, PoGB
content: Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri has appealed to the UN Human Rights Council for urgent intervention regarding deteriorating human rights conditions in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir. He emphasised the need for an independent investigation into alleged violations and arbitrary detentions, while also voicing concerns about the issues surrounding political representation and land rights in Pakistan-occupied Gilgit-Baltistan.

title: Anand Mahindra shares hill-station view where road appears to end at a rainbow
content: A stunning Himachal road recently caught the attention of ace industrialist Anand Mahindra which left him in awe and made him say, "Some destinations are not meant to be reached". Sharing the video on X, Mahindra wrote about how the sight reminded him of an idea he had held on to for decades: “You can never reach the end of a rainbow.” He drew a parallel between a rainbow and destinations. It’s something that keeps pulling you forward even when it remains beyond reach.

title: USCIS warns against websites and businesses ‘guaranteeing’ faster visa
content: USCIS has issued a warning to visa applicants regarding fraudulent businesses that claim to expedite processing times through alleged government ties for a fee. It is crucial for applicants to utilize official .gov resources and report any suspicious offers they encounter. The Department of Justice also provides lists of affordable legal immigration services, alongside tips from USCIS on correctly filling out both online and mailed application forms.

title: Indian Railways plans second Vande Bharat Sleeper on Delhi-Varanasi route
content: Indian Railways is set to launch its second Sleeper Vande Bharat service, which will link Delhi and Varanasi. Passengers can enjoy a comfortable overnight journey as the train travels through Kanpur and Prayagraj. This initiative seeks to improve the experience of long-distance rail travel in one of India's most frequented corridors.

title: Naomi Osaka’s family faced eviction before her Grand Slam success
content: During the evolution of her remarkable tennis career, which boasts four Grand Slam titles and a peak world ranking of number one, Naomi Osaka navigated challenging eviction notices. Beyond her athletic achievements, she has ventured into investments and sports ownership, notably launching successful skincare and media companies. Currently, she is ambitiously embracing luxury fashion projects, showcasing her versatility beyond the tennis court.

title: Patrick Mahomes reflects on Chiefs’ win: What did he say after Week 2?
content: Patrick Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs’ popular quarterback, weighs in on his rcord breaking performance against the Indianapolis Colts in Week 2.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez’s $25m plot: What are they building?
content: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodríguez bought a €25 million plot on Dubai’s Jumeirah Bay Island in 2024 and planned a custom family mansion there. The move followed their decision to rent out their Madrid home for €10,000 a month. The Dubai property gives the family a major base closer to Ronaldo’s life with Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia.

title: Asian Games Medal Tally: Where does India rank after women's cricket retains gold?
content: India’s women's cricket team showcased their prowess once again, winning the gold medal at the Asian Games for the second time. Under the captaincy of Harmanpreet Kaur, they triumphed over Sri Lanka by an impressive 147 runs. This victory elevates India's medal standings to one gold, four silver, and two bronze, with anticipation building as more events, including badminton and wushu, unfold.

title: Trump touts Venezuela oil deal, says it will drive down energy prices worldwide
content: US President Donald Trump announced a major oil deal with Venezuela. This agreement covers sixty-five billion barrels of oil and aims to lower global energy costs.  The deal is expected to boost Venezuela's oil production significantly over time.  Experts, however, believe immediate price changes are unlikely due to infrastructure needs.  Trump also linked this policy to wider US interests in the Western Hemisphere.

title: Embassy sells Juhu tower to Angel One founder Thakkar for Rs 711 cr
content: Embassy Developments has finalized a pivotal MoU for a luxury residential sale involving an entire tower at Embassy Terrazza located in Juhu. Dinesh Thakkar, the founder of Angel One, has acquired this prestigious residence, with the deal amounting to around Rs 711 crore, inclusive of all expenses. This transaction stands as the largest single residential unit sale for the developer in India.

title: Foreign cycling coach booked under POCSO for 'raping' minor athlete; passport seized
content: A 34-year-old Kazakhstan coach attached to the Indian cycling squad has been booked under the POCSO Act for allegedly raping a minor cyclist at the National Centre of Excellence in Patiala. Police have issued a lookout circular against Maxat Ayazbayev, seized his passport and formed two teams to trace him after he allegedly went untraceable following the complaint. The Cycling Federation of India has also suspended him, while raids are underway in Delhi and the NCR.

title: Yash Dayal back in Uttar Pradesh Ranji Trophy camp
content: Yash Dayal is set to return to Uttar Pradesh's Ranji Trophy setup, ending a prolonged period away from competitive cricket. He is being included in the Uttar Pradesh Ranji Trophy camp, starting on Friday in Lucknow. Dayal has not played any competitive cricket since the IPL 2025 final, which RCB won.

title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over 2019 Easter Sunday bombings
content: A Sri Lankan court found fifteen men guilty for their roles in the 2019 Easter bombings. These coordinated attacks tragically killed over two hundred sixty people across the island nation. Prosecutors stated one convicted man masterminded the devastating suicide bombings which targeted churches and hotels. Authorities filed over twenty-three thousand charges against twenty-four suspects in this significant legal proceeding.

title: Asiad: India win 1st gold, assure medals in badminton, wushu on action-packed day
content: India won its first gold of the 2026 Asian Games as Harmanpreet Kaur-led side defended the women's cricket title with a 147-run victory over Sri Lanka. The men's badminton team and wushu star Roshibina Devi assured medals, while hockey, boxing and gymnastics produced strong results amid mixed fortunes in shooting and table tennis.

title: Gurugram collapses in rains while Greater Noida planned for 30-40 years: SC
content: The Supreme Court noted Gurugram's infrastructure collapses during rains due to inadequate investment. Greater Noida was planned for the next forty years, unlike Gurugram. The court heard a plea challenging Karnataka's Premium Floor Area Ratio scheme. This scheme allows purchasing additional construction rights by paying premium charges. The court clarified the scheme should not regularize illegal construction.

title: Mahindra Thar OG launched: Prices, variants, features and more
content: Mahindra has launched the new Thar OG with a new platform and revised suspension.  It offers more powerful engine options and additional safety features for buyers.  The SUV receives styling updates and interior enhancements for improved comfort.  Deliveries for the updated Thar OG are scheduled to begin in October 2026.  Prices for the new Thar OG start at Rs 10.32 lakh ex-showroom.

title: India-Japan T20I wide row: What laws say about umpire's reversal of decision
content: Japan needed six runs from the last four balls while chasing India's 32 for 4. But the match took another turn when a wide call was reversed after protests from India.

title: Rani Mukerji's mother's funeral: SRK, Alia, Anil Kapoor arrive to pay last respects
content: In a heartbreaking turn of events, Rani Mukerji's mother, Krishna Mukerji, has died at seventy-five, as confirmed by Yash Raj Films, which also asked for family privacy. Friends from the film industry, including Shah Rukh Khan, gathered to pay their respects at the funeral on Tuesday. Krishna was instrumental in nurturing Rani's passion for acting from an early age. Rani’s recent projects include 'Mardaani 3' and the upcoming film 'King.'

title: 7pm temple, 7.30 park, 8.45 PCR call: Timeline of how 3 fake cops gang-raped Delhi teen

One assailant allegedly threatened the girl with a firearm and a knife during the assault. Police received a PCR call and later apprehended one accused, Asif, after an exchange of fire.

title: After Jamui, Odisha tourist couple harassed on way to Kapilash temple; 2 detained
content: Police in Odisha’s Dhenkanal detained two people after a video allegedly showing a tourist couple being harassed and the man assaulted on the road to Kapilash shrine surfaced on social media. Police registered a case and began investigating the incident, including the roles of others who may have been involved. The action comes a day after a similar viral-video case in Bihar’s Jamui triggered multiple arrests.

title: Asian Games: Saurav Ghosal identifies India's biggest challenge, and incentive
content: Saurav Ghosal is watching his first Asian Games without a racquet in hand since 2002, but India's former squash star believes the country's medal hopes have never been clearer. As mentor to Anahat Singh, Ghosal discusses handling expectations, the significance of Olympic qualification, and why medals -- not promise -- must define India's squash campaign in Aichi-Nagoya.

title: 'I'm going to tell the truth': Netanyahu hits back at Mamdani ahead of UN speech
content: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is set to deliver a significant address at the United Nations General Assembly. In his speech, he intends to staunchly defend military operations conducted by Israel while also targeting New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani. Netanyahu has accused Mamdani of endorsing Hamas and fostering anti-Jewish sentiment, in response to Mamdani's previous remarks labeling him a war criminal responsible for genocide.

title: Who is Roshibina? Wushu star who faced selection row before assuring herself a medal
content: Naorem Roshibina Devi assured herself a third successive Asian Games medal after defeating Macao, China’s Chu Man Sin 5-0 in the women’s Sanda 60kg quarterfinal at Aichi-Nagoya. The Manipuri wushu star, who won bronze in 2018 and silver in 2023, reached the semifinals after a selection controversy preceded her return to the squad.

title: Gunmen kill 2 cops during polio vaccination drive in Pakistan's Balochistan
content: On Tuesday, gunmen in Balochistan province of Pakistan killed two police officers while they were safeguarding a door-to-door polio vaccination campaign. Thankfully, the health workers giving oral vaccine drops escaped without injury. Sadly, this incident highlights the ongoing security challenges that hamper vaccination drives in Pakistan, leaving it and Afghanistan as the last countries grappling with wild poliovirus transmission.

title: 72nd National Awards: Mammootty receives standing ovation, Dhanush honoured
content: Mammootty and Dhanush received their National Film Awards from President Droupadi Murmu, with both stars making classic appearances at the ceremony. Mammootty won Best Actor for 'Bramayugam,' while Dhanush’s 'Raayan' was honoured as Best Tamil Film, with his sons Yatra and Linga witnessing the moment. Their National Award reunion, along with director Rajkumar Periasamy and editor R Kalaivanan’s honours, has further raised expectations for 'OM.'

title: China building new next-generation submarine as India's numbers stay constant
content: Fresh satellite imagery of China’s Bohai Shipyard shows a submarine believed to be a possible Type 095 nuclear-powered attack submarine under construction. The vessel features an apparent pumpjet propulsion system and X-shaped stern, suggesting efforts to improve stealth, efficiency and manoeuvrability. The development has regional implications as Pakistan expands its submarine fleet with eight Chinese-designed Hangor-class AIP submarines, expected to raise its fleet to 11. India operates 16 conventional and three strategic submarines, but fleet expansion has been delayed. Programmes including P-75I, Project-76 and indigenous nuclear attack submarines are progressing, but deliveries remain years away.

title: Watch: Trump calls Cuba a 'failed state', delegation walks out
content:
Trump announced that his administration is seeking a “fundamental change” in the situation in Cuba (Photo: PTI).

US President Donald Trump on Tuesday called Cuba a ‘failed state’ prompting the Cuban delegation to walk out during his speech. Trump’s remarks came as he addressed the United Nations General Assembly. “It’s an absolutely failed state. It’s failing like never before and it will fall,” said Trump, adding that the country is facing significant pressure under his administration. Trump announced that his administration is seeking a “fundamental change” in the situation in Cuba, which he said is run by a communist regime. “Freedom will come to Cuba”, Trump said.

title: ‘You shouldn’t be here covering me’: Trump confronts CNN’s Kaitlan Collins at UN amid White House ban
content: president Donald Trump confronted CNN correspondent Kaitlan Collins at the u.n. general assembly . she asked him when the war with Iran would end . he told him: "you should not be here covering me. You said you weren't going to cover me. you shouldn't be covering me"
